title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 2: The Last Door
description: Travel to Neri for water. A failing pump traps Tao below: your preparations and decisions determine who survives, how much water returns, and whether An still stands beside you. Short Mandarin with audio, pinyin and meanings.

teaser.prompt: Animate this exact shonen anime illustration, preserving the adult bearded Jedi Jonathan on the left and adult woman An on the right, their faces, clothes, proportions and all setting details. Single continuous six-second shot. ONE meaningful action: Jonathan extends his already-raised open palm slightly further to warn An to stop opening the hatch. An pauses, releases the handle and turns her eyes toward him, realizing the danger. The metal hatch stays CLOSED the entire time. Both hold a tense listening pause. Tiny natural cloak and ponytail movement, subtle warning-light flicker, quiet water trickle. Restrained dramatic anime motion, consistent clean linework, no camera cut, no zoom, no additional people. Native sound: a metallic creak, quiet water trickle, faint machinery hum only. NO speech, words, narration, music, humming voices or lyrics. Both mouths settle closed and remain closed. No lightsaber ignition, no fighting, no door opening, no character injury, no new objects, no text or logos. End on the unresolved silent decision.
